summary: Worthington Steel, Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending its June 3, 2026 8-K to provide Item 9.01 financial statements and pro forma information for its completed acquisition of Klöckner & Co SE. The Original 8-K reported completion of the acquisition under Item 2.01; this amendment adds audited consolidated financials for Klöckner for fiscal 2024/2025 and interim 2026 figures, plus unaudited pro forma combined statements. No new deal terms are disclosed in this amendment. The acquisition is complete; this filing fulfills SEC reporting requirements. What to watch: integration execution and combined operating results.
